sources.title: Quality control of Semen Ziziphi Spinosae standard decoction based on determination of multi-components using TOF-MS/MS and UPLC-PDA technology
sources.support: Abstract and component list include protocatechuic acid and catechin among chromatographically determined constituents of standard decoction.
sources.scope_limit: Different extract/material and study; not presence, content or origin evidence for the current855THz specimens.
sources.access: PMC full text opened once; subsequent find requests met CAPTCHA; no article mirrored.

sources.title: PubChem Protocatechuic Acid CID72
sources.support: Indexed official formula C7H6O4 and identity.
sources.access: Official indexed record; direct open CAPTCHA.

sources.title: PubChem Catechin CID9064
sources.support: Indexed official formula C15H14O6 and stereochemical InChI.
sources.scope_limit: Does not resolve which optical isomer the standard/decoction contains.
sources.access: Official indexed record; direct open CAPTCHA.

sources.title: Terahertz and Raman Spectroscopic Investigation of Monohydrate Cocrystal of Antitubercular Isoniazid with Protocatechuic Acid
sources.support: THz/Raman and DFT study of INH-protocatechuic-acid monohydrate cocrystal.
sources.scope_limit: Cocrystal plus water differs from pure acid and herbal mixtures; no mode positions reused.
sources.access: Official indexed abstract verified; publisher open429; PMC direct CAPTCHA.

sources.title: Structures, Infrared Spectra and Reactivities of (+)-Catechin Metal Complexes
sources.authors: Wang Xiao-Wei, Jiang Gang, Du Ji-Guang
sources.support: Publisher abstract reports B3LYP/6-311+G(d,p) calculations for catechin and metal complexes; evidence of an existing calculation approach, not this project running it.
sources.scope_limit: IR/complex study does not establish low-frequency solid herbal assignments.

sources.title: First principles terahertz spectroscopy of molecular crystals: the crucial role of periodic boundary conditions benchmarked with experimental L-ascorbic acid spectra
sources.support: Its crystal benchmark illustrates sensitivity to intermolecular structure and periodic boundary treatment.
sources.scope_limit: Other molecular material; does not prove every herbal mixture requires one specific code or assign its peaks.
sources.access: Previously inspected indexed official abstract; frozen main sources remain unchanged.
